name: Gilbert Redford
original_name: ギルバート・レッドフォード
source:
"This is just a present, as long as you accept it with a smile then it'll be fine."

The boss of the Visconti Family. 
A flashy ore-sama type who is very confident, but he also has a friendly attitude to anyone. 
He's opposed to the Falzone Famly who have a different way of thinking. 
He's an innovative thinker who isn't bound by tradition, he loves freedom.
